doc.name: Aginera
doc.description: Construction preconstruction for agents: quantity takeoffs, measured routes (conduit, duct, pipe, tray) and schedules from drawing sets, plus PDF→CAD conversion (free to convert and view, one-time purchase to download) — on the user's own Aginera account.

oauth2.description: OAuth 2.1 authorization code + PKCE on the user's Aginera account (dynamic client registration and client ID metadata documents supported).

skills.name: Quantity takeoff
skills.description: Extract quantities (fixtures, devices, equipment, linear runs) from electrical, mechanical, plumbing, fire-protection and process drawing sets. Uses credits; MCP tools list_takeoffs (existing runs, incl. web app) / run_takeoff → get_takeoff → get_takeoff_items.
examples: Take off the electrical scope from this drawing set.
How many 2x4 troffers are on Level 2?

skills.name: Measured routes
skills.description: Measured conduit, feeder, branch circuit, cable tray, duct and pipe runs with endpoints and totals by system (get_takeoff_routes).
examples: How much conduit is shown on Level 2?

skills.name: Schedules
skills.description: Panel, fixture, equipment and mechanical schedules as structured rows (get_schedules).
examples: List the panel schedules and their circuit counts.

skills.name: PDF to CAD conversion
skills.description: Convert a PDF drawing (vector or scanned) to editable CAD. Converting and viewing are free; the DXF/DWG download is a one-time purchase per document on free accounts. MCP tools convert_pdf_to_cad → get_cad_file.
examples: Convert this PDF floor plan to DXF.
I need this drawing as a DWG.

skills.name: Export
skills.description: Export a takeoff as CSV, Excel or JSON (create_export) — a time-limited download link.
